title: I built RoadThruster, a playable Three.js racing game inspired by the new Tesla Roadster (Promo video made with Opus 5.5)
author: yoonkhong
selftext:
Slightly late to the party, but I've been cooking up a web racing game inspired by Tesla's new Roadster. I was busy working on a bunch of other game releases, yet had to fast-track this one after the recent announcement.

Built the game and put together this promo video both using Opus 5.5.

You can play it right in your browser here: [https://roadthruster.versezero.com/](https://roadthruster.versezero.com/)

Multiplayer is coming soon, so right now I'm focusing on tuning the core solo gameplay and thruster feel. Let me know how it runs on your setup and what you think!

comments.author: GlobalCurry
comments.body: Giving me San Francisco Rush/ Rush 2049 vibes.
